name: knowledge
description: Marketplace for the knowledge plugin: a personal knowledge base with an explain skill and a KB scaffolder.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Explain what code in your repo does, or a code change in it, as a native chapter — Markdown with typed blocks for diagrams, figures, callouts and a quiz — in your own knowledge base, written only from the code and what your workspace's phases recorded, with no research of its own. It runs as an explain phase in a workflow workspace (v94 or later): one confirmation, then one writer, one critic and a private publish. One setup skill connects the hosted KB or scaffolds your own.
